release_candidate_history: The first candidate (source d6b3cf18) failed in packaged builds and on Android: release export templates reject the bare free Callable in mp_camp_host.gd, so the main menu and dependent scripts did not compile. The editor build used by source tests accepts it. 424649b1 frees the host with call_deferred("free"); every platform was rebuilt and every packaged, device and browser check here was repeated on the rebuilt candidate.

limits: Linux Vulkan tested on an NVIDIA RTX 3090. Windows Direct3D 12 (DXR) and Vulkan packages exercised under Wine/VKD3D on that host; a physical Windows system was not available.
Android installed and started to the main menu on a Retroid Pocket 5; macOS passed source/archive/branding checks without target-device runtime testing.
Ray-traced lighting and path tracing are experimental and off by default; they cost GPU time and moving scenes can remain noisy.
Pre-existing source-tree test failures that also fail without this release (listed under source_tests.preexisting_failures) were not addressed here.
Browser validation covers WebAssembly startup to the installation screen and the 1.24.0 to 1.25.0 cache upgrade with stored data preserved; it does not import original game data.

deployment.scope: Every changed hosted asset, complete service-worker engine cache, build metadata and split WebAssembly parts
